propositions: A new module `repeat_fix.py` with predicates `REPEAT_FIX_WINDOW_DAYS=7` and `REPEAT_FIX_MIN_PRIOR=2` must detect when a non-test file has been touched by ≥2 prior bug-fix commits within 7 days on the base branch, escalating under-floor fixes to plan review.

The `apply_bugfix_size_gate` function must escalate fixes that exceed 150 non-test lines OR match the repeat-fix signal, preserving existing test exemptions and returning a verdict with new fields `escalation_reason` and `repeat_fix_priors` in coverage.

Existing test `test_under_threshold_diff_never_reads_the_store` must be rewritten to reflect that repeat-fix evaluation now runs on under-floor diffs, with the surviving invariant that under-floor diffs with no non-test files or no repeat-fix hit skip attestation classification.

The backtest script `backtest_bugfix_size.py` must gain `--repeat-fix` and `--labels-from-caused-by` options, importing the shipped predicate and reporting per-predicate recall against the `caused_by` label set from the metric store.

The `flagged` field must continue to mean the size floor alone; the repeat-fix verdict is a separate field, preserving the `--check-planning-corpus` invariant that flagged equals `ADJUDICATED_SUBSTANTIVE` exactly.

Documentation at `docs/plan-review-gate.md` must record the repeat-fix predicate, its parameters, and explain why the `review-plan` mirror is a no-op because `bug_blast_radius_escalates` already escalates any bug with non-test `file_impact`.
